origin: The Hansen World RX Team emerged from a long and storied rallycross heritage within the Hansen family. Kenneth Hansen, a legend in European Rallycross with 14 European Championship titles to his name, laid the foundation. His passion, passed down to his sons Timmy and Kevin, spurred the creation of a dedicated team focused on achieving world championship glory. Initially a modest operation run from the family farm, the team gradually attracted factory support, transforming from plucky privateers to a force to be reckoned with.
philosophy: The team's philosophy centers around a blend of Swedish ingenuity and unwavering determination. They embrace a data-driven approach to car development, focusing on incremental improvements and optimizing performance across diverse track conditions. The team culture emphasizes family values, fostering a supportive and collaborative environment where every member's contribution is valued, creating a strong bond that translates into on-track success.
achievements: Multiple FIA World Rallycross Championship race wins
Consistently challenging for the FIA World Rallycross Championship team title
Development of innovative suspension and engine technology
Cultivating the careers of Timmy and Kevin Hansen to become world-class drivers

teamPrincipal.name: Kenneth Hansen
teamPrincipal.background: Kenneth Hansen, the patriarch of the Hansen family, brings decades of rallycross experience to the role. His calm demeanor and deep understanding of the sport provides a steady hand, guiding the team with wisdom and strategic insight.

keyFigures.name: Timmy Hansen
keyFigures.description: Timmy Hansen is a highly skilled and experienced driver, known for his aggressive driving style and unwavering commitment. He is a multiple race winner and a consistent championship contender.

keyFigures.name: Kevin Hansen
keyFigures.description: Kevin Hansen, Timmy's younger brother, is a rising star in rallycross. He possesses immense talent and determination, continually pushing himself and the team to achieve greater heights.

keyFigures.name: Susann Hansen
keyFigures.description: Susann Hansen is the organizational backbone of the team, ensuring smooth operations and efficient logistics. Her dedication and attention to detail contribute significantly to the team's success.

headquarters: The Hansen World RX Team operates from a modern facility located near Götene, Sweden. The facilities include a well-equipped workshop, engine dyno, and advanced data analysis center, allowing for comprehensive car development and preparation.
fanBase: The team enjoys a loyal and passionate fanbase, particularly in Scandinavia, drawn to their family-oriented values, fierce competitiveness, and the captivating driving styles of Timmy and Kevin Hansen. They are particularly popular with younger audiences, who see them as approachable and inspiring figures.
